headline: World Series Game 5: Brewers @ Rays, 5:00 PM PT on FOX. Milwaukee leads 3-1 after Tampa won Game 4 in 12 innings. Misiorowski starts for the Brewers. Plus NHL. WNBA Finals Game 6 is Thursday.

record.label: Yesterday (Tue 10/27)
record.note: A bad night. The Rays rallied in the 12th to win 4-3, beating the Brewers ML and the SGP. Hellebuyck shut down the Stars in his Devils debut, and Blue Jackets-Flyers went to OT over the total. Only the Panthers (5-1) hit. The Contreras prop couldn't be confirmed.

notes: The board is down about 4 units overall after two losing days. Today's card is short on purpose.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edge on today's card. Tuesday these went 1-3. One main play today: the best starter in baseball against a worn-out Rays staff.

straight.reasoning: SI and TheSpread both pick Milwaukee. Misiorowski led the majors with a 1.80 ERA and 252 strikeouts, is on full rest, and allowed one run over five innings against Tampa in Game 1. The Rays have no rested starter after a 12-inning Game 4, so it's Rasmussen on three days' rest or another bullpen game. The line has moved from -128 to -155 in Milwaukee's favor. Risk: Milwaukee's bullpen also worked deep Tuesday. Prices range from -141 to -155; playable to -155.
